name: Descriptions
usage: Basic information on detail pages and in drawers, metadata of an API

props.name: items
props.description: The fields: `label` and the value in `children`. To show a field conditionally, leave it out of the array.

props.name: column
props.description:
Number of columns of equal width. By default it follows the width of the window: 1 below 576 px, 2 from
576 px, 3 from 768 px and 4 from 1920 px. When the last row is not full, its last field takes the remaining
columns.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in drawers and panels, where the fields are close together.

types.name: DescriptionsItem
types.summary: A field in the `items` of Descriptions.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key; the position in the list by default.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Give the fields in `items`; `column` sets the number of columns.

examples.name: Conditional
examples.title: Fields shown conditionally
examples.description: Leave a field out of `items` when it has no value; `size="sm"` fits drawers and panels.
